comment: Packages with zero internal, non-test callers, declared on purpose. check_orphan_packages.py fails on any orphan package missing here, or on a stale entry: one whose package no longer exists, or one that has gained a real caller. permanent=false means an internal caller is expected later, named in target. permanent=true means this package is a composition root or a test-only fixture, consumed only by application code outside this module or only from another package's _test directory, and target names that consumer.

envfile.reason: Dotenv parser leaf. No package reads its output yet.

workspace.reason: Filesystem confinement leaf. Its only internal caller was subagent's file-editing toolbox (FileTools, WorkspaceReadTool, WorkspaceWriteTool, WorkspaceListTool, WorkspaceStatTool, DiffTool), removed as coding-agent product surface; see docs/plans/agents/convergence.md's 'Boundary correction' section. No internal caller remains. Its own import, secretpath, is reachable only through workspace, so a future consumer must take both.

longtermmemory.reason: Ported from mivia-agent as a leaf package. The intended SDK hook is an agentloop system-prompt hook rendering CoreFrame plus a subagent save/search tool; until then no package wires it into a running agent.
longtermmemory.target: an agentloop system-prompt hook rendering CoreFrame, plus a subagent save/search tool

mcp.reason: MCP client leaf. Its consumer is external application code: mivia-agent imports it at 22 call sites as of 2026-09-07.

skills.reason: Skill registry leaf; mivia-agent's B.0.5 internal/sdkadapter/skill.go bridges it as the first consumer, but no SDK-internal package imports it yet.

agentloop.reason: Model tool-calling loop, a composition package meant for an external agent implementation, not another SDK package. The external consumer exists: mivia-agent's internal/agent agentloop_adapter.go (verified 2026-09-07) builds agentloop.Options and sets Model, OnToolCallError, Trim, Surface, StreamingWriter, and ContinueOnStop. Only OnToolError stays at its default there. The docs/examples/_agentloop composition example is the in-repo positive control: verify-fast runs it and asserts its final output. agentloop in turn has Scope-gated schema validation, a documented Result-shape contract, structured Audit, Tracer spans, and an explicit ErrorPolicy switch that mivia-agent lacks.
agentloop.target: external application code; the live consumer is mivia-agent's internal/agent agentloop_adapter.go

a2aack.reason: Edge adapter turning a remote A2A task round trip into agent.AckWait, per its AGENTS.md entry. No consumer today: mivia-agent has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07. Kept as SDK surface.
a2aack.target: no consumer today; kept as SDK surface

a2aloopback.reason: Test-only fixture. AGENTS.md's a2aclient entry calls it 'the loopback test fixture,' imported only from a2aclient and a2aack _test subdirectories, which this scan excludes.

dispatch.reason: NDJSON envelope HTTP endpoint. No consumer today: mivia-agent has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07; it ships its own HTTP wiring. Kept as SDK surface.
dispatch.target: no consumer today; kept as SDK surface

durablefence.reason: Test-only conformance kit. AGENTS.md states it is imported only from another package's _test subdirectory.
durablefence.target: ledger/ledger_test and other packages' _test subdirectories only

e2e.reason: End-to-end scenario harness. Its intended callers are its own e2e_test subdirectory and subagent/subagent_test/helpers_test.go, both test code, by design.

runconfig.reason: JSON-config composition layer over agentrun. No consumer today: mivia-agent has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07; no deployment main package loads it yet. Kept as SDK surface.
runconfig.target: no consumer today; kept as SDK surface

contextsession.reason: Durable session planner carved out of contextplan. Intended caller is external application code adapting Plan to agentloop.Options.Trim.
contextsession.target: agentloop or an external session-backed runner; see docs/plans/spool.md's read-back section

provider/anthropic.reason: Anthropic Messages API adapter leaf. No external consumer today: mivia-agent has zero references to it as of 2026-09-07; it ships its own internal/provider/anthropic.go. In-repo callers are the e2e wire test and the agentloop composition example.
provider/anthropic.target: no external consumer today; in-repo callers are the e2e wire test and the agentloop composition example
